method: Native-image visual annotation; approximate y coordinates ±20 px, excludes ears. Uniform normalization controls display scale, not depth/lens or head pitch.

rows.normalization: uniform full-image scale to equal crown-to-sole height; no head/body warping
rows.interpretation: Projected screening measurement only: crown/chin vary with head rotation. Not a universal ratio or production acceptance threshold.
